Congressional forecasters said this week they expect the federal deficit to top $2 trillion this year — about $200 billion more than they were projecting six months ago.

That's pushing the government's cumulative debt close to $40 trillion. Just paying interest on that costs more than a trillion dollars a year, eclipsing every other federal program besides Social Security.
